title: Isoliensinine suppresses chondrocytes pyroptosis against osteoarthritis via the MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Zhengze; Ma, Jizhi; Yi, Yanzi; Wang, Shuai; He, Yuewen; Liu, Yurui; Meng, Kai; Wang, Yong; Ma, Wuhua
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Isoliensinine通过MAPK/NF-kappaB通路抑制软骨细胞焦亡治疗骨关节炎，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Isoliensinine is an active compound derived from Nelumbo nucifera which has long been used for its anti-inflammatory properties. However, the mechanism of Isoliensinine in the treatment of osteoarthritis is poorly known. PURPOSE: The present study aims to investigate whether Isoliensinine could alleviate osteoarthritis by regulating MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway-mediated pyroptosis. METHODS: Network pharmacology and KEGG enrichment analysis were used to identify the therapeutic targets of Isoliensinine for OA. Molecular docking was used to confirm the binding ability of Isoliensinine and related proteins. In vitro, chondrocytes were stimulated with IL-1beta to construct an inflammatory model and treated with Isoliensinine. The viability of the cells was assessed using the CCK-8 kit. The apoptosis rate of cells was measured using Annexin V-FITC/PI assay. And assessed the levels of ROS, lipid-ROS, and mitochondrial membrane potential. Corresponding assay kits were utilized to measure the levels of MDA and SOD. Subsequently, the anabolic and catabolic markers in chondrocytes, alongside inflammatory targets were measured by RT-PCR and Western blot. The expression level of pyroptosis and MAPK/NF-kappaB signaling pathway-related targets was examined. Furthermore, we constructed a rat osteoarthritis model using ACLT surgery. We then assessed the progression of osteoarthritis by Micro-CT, H&E staining, S&F staining and immunohistochemistry. RESULTS: Enrichment analysis showed that Isoliensinine treatment of osteoarthritis may be through the MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway, and molecular docking showed that Isoliensinine and MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway proteins had a good binding ability. Data showed that Isoliensinine could reduce ECM degradation and inflammation, and inhibit IL-1beta-induced apoptosis. It also mitigated ROS and LPO activation, regulated mitochondrial dysfunction, and reduced intracellular oxidative stress levels. Furthermore, Western blot showed that Isoliensinine also inhibited the activation of the MAPK/NF-kappaB pathway, thereby inhibiting the pyroptosis of chondrocytes. In vivo, Micro-CT, H&E staining and S&F staining results showed that Isoliensinine could effectively improve joint damage caused by osteoarthritis. And IHC analyses indicated NLRP3, MMP3 protein expression were significantly diminished and Collagen II expression was increased in the Isoliensinine treatment groups. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, our study suggested that Isoliensinine mitigates ECM degradation, oxidative stress, chondrocytes apoptosis, and pyroptosis through the inhibition of the MAPK and NF-kappaB pathways, thereby delaying the progression of osteoarthritis.
abstract_zh: 背景：异莲心碱（Isoliensinine）是从莲（Nelumbo nucifera）中提取的一种活性化合物，长期以来因其抗炎特性而被使用。然而，异莲心碱在治疗骨关节炎中的机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨异莲心碱是否通过调节MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路介导的细胞焦亡来缓解骨关节炎。方法：采用网络药理学和KEGG富集分析来识别异莲心碱治疗OA的靶点。使用分子对接来确认异莲心碱与相关蛋白的结合能力。在体外实验中，用IL-1beta刺激软骨细胞构建炎症模型，并用异莲心碱处理。使用CCK-8试剂盒评估细胞活力。使用Annexin V-FITC/PI检测细胞凋亡率，并评估ROS、脂质ROS和线粒体膜电位水平。使用相应的检测试剂盒测量MDA和SOD水平。随后，通过RT-PCR和Western blot测量软骨细胞中的合成代谢和分解代谢标志物以及炎症靶点。检测了细胞焦亡和MAPK/NF-kappaB信号通路相关靶点的表达水平。此外，我们通过ACLT手术构建了大鼠骨关节炎模型。然后通过Micro-CT、H&E染色、S&F染色和免疫组化评估骨关节炎的进展。结果：富集分析显示，异莲心碱治疗骨关节炎可能通过MAPK/NF-kappaB通路实现，分子对接显示异莲心碱与MAPK/NF-kappaB通路蛋白具有良好的结合能力。数据显示，异莲心碱能减少ECM降解和炎症，并抑制IL-1beta诱导的细胞凋亡。它还减轻了ROS和LPO的激活，调节了线粒体功能障碍，并降低了细胞内氧化应激水平。此外，Western blot显示异莲心碱还抑制了MAPK/NF-kappaB通路的激活，从而抑制软骨细胞的焦亡。在体内实验中，Micro-CT、H&E染色和S&F染色结果显示，异莲心碱能有效改善骨关节炎引起的关节损伤。IHC分析表明，在异莲心碱治疗组中，NLRP3、MMP3蛋白表达显著降低，而Collagen II表达增加。结论：总之，我们的研究表明，异莲心碱通过抑制MAPK和NF-kappaB通路来减轻ECM降解、氧化应激、软骨细胞凋亡和焦亡，从而延缓骨关节炎的进展。
